data.title: The Trade Desk: Hold Rating Maintained as Restructuring Offsets Execution Risks; Price Target Reaffirmed at $16
data.description:
Analyst Youssef Squali from Truist Financial maintained a Hold rating on Trade Desk and keeping the price target at $16.00.

Youssef Squali has given his Hold rating due to a combination of factors tied to both near‑term challenges and longer‑term strengths at The Trade Desk. He views the 15% workforce reduction and broader restructuring as a sensible move to defend profitability and free cash flow while the company works through revenue headwinds in key verticals and addresses recent execution issues.

Squali also highlights that the company’s robust balance sheet, solid free cash flow generation, and ongoing share repurchases provide downside support, yet he remains cautious given the significant C‑suite turnover and the need to prove that the new leadership team can deliver more stable operating performance. With execution risk still elevated and earnings underperformance not fully attributable to macro conditions, he keeps his price target unchanged at $16 and prefers to stay neutral until the reset strategy demonstrates more consistent results.
